subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

She is proficient in __speaking many languages__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Monolithic"** means something large, powerful, and intractably indivisible and uniform. (एकरूप)

 
 
• **Example: **The **monolithic **structure of the organization made it difficult to implement changes.
 
 
 
• **"Multilingual" **refers to a person who is able to speak multiple languages fluently. (बहुभाषी)
 
 
• **Example: **As a multilingual individual, she easily converses with people from different countries.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word **"multilingual" **is the correct substitute for the phrase "proficient in speaking many languages".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Multilingual**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Monolithic **(एकरूप): Large, powerful, and intractably indivisible and uniform.

 
 
• **Example: **The monolithic structure of the organization made it difficult to implement changes.
 
 
 
• **Heterolinguistic **(विविधभाषी): Relating to or involving several languages.
 
 
• **Example: **The heterolinguistic community had members speaking various native languages.
 
 
 
• **Bilingual** (द्विभाषी): A person fluent in two languages.
 
 
• **Example:** Being bilingual, he easily switches between English and Spanish.
 
 

33:Td47,

The correct answer is: Option 1.</b&
